Milestone — closed `verminous-zealous-krill` (`4312-882e-e92c-4da5`).

- Scope remained comments/documentation only: `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml`, `.github/dependabot.yml`, and `.github/pull_request_template.md`.
- Gerrit change 2742 landed as `08033c6ae93126110c35cb936a58ce3145e77eb2` with `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, and zero unresolved comments; CI run 34091418400 passed all 22 jobs without retries.
- Independent semantic review recorded a 15-row TSV PASS receipt; YAML data was byte-identical and all 22 visible pull-request-template lines were unchanged.
- Refreshed plan-review job `1788765164760037000-b2839562435d4da083df82032213130d` passed and signed at the landed SHA.
- Exactly one completion-verifier job was started: `1788765502445969343-0be94067972b4c4fbc209d3bd45920d0`; it returned PASS and its certificate verified at the landed SHA.
- Closed through MCP with `--ref` semantics pinned to the landed SHA, without force. Shared tracker now reports `closed` with current plan-review and completion-verifier attestations.
- Per operator direction, no full local test suite was run; scoped guards and Gerrit CI supplied validation.
